     1. Change your password
     2. Work with user profiles
     3. Work with authorization lists

     5. Work with security auditing

notes: IBM stock SECURITY menu (QSYS/SECURITY). *USER class sees only option 1. Option 8 runs GO SECTOOLS (requires authority). Lab GO SECURITY menu in src/screen-runtime/screens/mainMenu.ts is an expanded training hub — align labels separately or document as synthetic.
